card.name: P in Pneumocystis after opportunistic infections
card.fires_on: The letter P that starts Pneumocystis (jirovecii) in a list of opportunistic infections after cytomegalovirus. It appears in immune reconstitution warnings.

modes.label: Pneumocystis spelled out
modes.description: The first letter P of Pneumocystis, listed after Mycobacterium avium infection and cytomegalovirus.
modes.example: develop an inflammatory response to indolent or residual opportunistic infections (such as Mycobacterium avium infection, cytomegalovirus,<< P>>neumocystis jirovec

card.writes: It promotes word starts like th, tox, rub and lys, which do not clearly fit the context, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the P that begins Pneumocystis in a list of infections that can flare when the immune system recovers.
